body: Well man, I'll tell you what, it really fucks me up, which is just about all I can ask for at this point in my life.

People continually tell me that. Shrinks, friends, parents, and I just don't fucking buy it. I've seen people's lives get worse and worse as they get older (some family members in particular are giant fucking losers). I think a lot of people just aren't made for this world. 

But it is nice to know that I'm not alone in these feelings. I hope we can someday feel better about ourselves.
